section.title: Activity
section.para: Your teacher will give you a set of cards. Take turns with your partner to match a group of 4 cards that contain: a situation, an inequality that represents it, a graph that represents the solution region, and a solution written as a coordinate pair.
For each match that you find, explain to your partner how you know it's a match.
For each match that your partner finds, listen carefully to their explanation. If you disagree, discuss your thinking and work to reach an agreement.

problem.para: Write down your answer, then select the solution button to compare your work.
